summary: Tank whose lane is about short trades and map pressure. He blocks autos with W, taunts with E, and at level 5 can ult to save a teammate anywhere. Spell damage and %HP damage beat him; ping his R when he leaves lane.
threats: W (Spirit's Refuge) blocks auto-attacks for allies in the zone. Spell damage still hits.
E (Shadow Dash) dashes and taunts; it's his engage and his escape.
Q (Twilight Assault) empowers his autos with %HP damage when he pulls his spirit blade through you.
R (Stand United) at 5: he shields and teleports to an ally anywhere. Ping when he leaves lane.

matchups.why: Gwen's damage is magic and her Q is a spell, so Shen's W can't block it. Her %HP damage shreds his tankiness, and her mist blocks his taunt follow-up from outside.
trading: Stack Q with autos, then land the centre of the final snip for true damage.
Use W (Hallowed Mist) to block his damage from outside the mist.
E (Skip 'n Slash) to close distance after he's used his taunt.
Don't auto into his W zone; use your Q instead.
matchups.early: Trade with full-stack Q and back off. He can't out-trade your %HP damage.
matchups.spike: At 5 he'll R to help other lanes. Ping it, then push his tower or take plates.
matchups.wave: Slow-push so he has to choose between ulting and losing plates.
matchups.jungle: His escape is E. Gank once he's used it.
matchups.build: Conqueror. AP bruiser items with %HP damage.

matchups.why: Mordekaiser's damage is all spells, so Shen's W does nothing against it. His Q isolation damage chunks Shen, and his R takes Shen out of the fight entirely.
trading: Q (Obliterate) him when he walks up to farm; spells ignore his W.
E (Death's Grasp) pull him into your Q for burst.
Use W (Indestructible) to absorb his Q-empowered autos.
Walk sideways out of his E taunt path.
matchups.early: Trade freely with Q; his W doesn't block it and he can't trade back well.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R takes him into a 1v1. He'll R to other lanes; ping it and push his tower.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and pressure his tower; make him choose between ulting and losing plates.
matchups.jungle: His escape is E. Gank once he's used it.

matchups.why: Darius out-damages Shen in extended fights with Hemorrhage stacks, but Shen's W blocks Darius's autos and his E taunt disrupts the combo. The lane is about Darius trading when W is down.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull him when his W is on cooldown.
Use Q, not autos, while his W is up; spells still hit.
Walk sideways out of his E taunt path.
Hit the outer edge of Q on him for damage and healing.
matchups.early: Even. Trade when his W is down so your autos and Hemorrhage actually land.
matchups.spike: At 5 he'll R to other lanes. Ping it, then push his tower or take plates.
matchups.wave: Slow-push so he has to choose between ulting and losing plates.
matchups.jungle: His escape is E. Gank once he's used it.

matchups.why: Tryndamere's damage is all autos, and Shen's W blocks them entirely. Shen's E taunt forces Tryndamere into bad trades, and he can't out-damage Shen's tankiness in lane.
trading: Don't auto into his W zone; walk out and wait for it to end.
Use E (Spinning Slash) to dodge his E taunt path.
Trade only when his W is on cooldown.
Use Q (Bloodlust) to heal off his poke instead of trading back.
matchups.early: Farm and build Fury. Trade only when his W is on cooldown.
matchups.spike: At 5 he'll R to other lanes. Ping it, then push his tower or split-push.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and split-push when he leaves lane to ult.
matchups.jungle: His escape is E. Gank once he's used it.
matchups.build: Lethal Tempo. Crit and attack speed.
